title: Rankar
label: Dhara Shah
description: A 23-track 2025 album by Dhara Shah, released under the Dhara Shah label and catalogued across traditional Garba, Mataji devotional, Krishna Garba and folk/lokgeet; the provider album and official continuous YouTube performance remain distinct where their programmes differ.
notes: Amazon Music exposes the canonical 23-track August 25, 2025 album, including provider-published track order, durations and individual song links. Dhara Shah's Official Artist Channel independently verifies the Rankar performance programme. The YouTube chapter list is not assumed to be a one-for-one representation of the streaming album because Chhogala Tara and Chhand appear where the provider album lists Rangalo and Duho. Exact playback therefore uses the explicit Amazon song links instead of inferred YouTube chapter mappings.
